body: How about a `[codeblocks][gdscript]` to show how to create an instance of this class in GDScript?
Maybe we can be a bit defensive about this and assert that `index_format` is either u16 or u32, otherwise silly things are going to happen and it would be difficult to figure out why.
If it makes sense, we can assert here as well.
The enumeration only has U16 and U32, so it should be fine. The same exact check is done in other several places.
